shimmer.$description: How long the shimmer band of a Skeleton takes to cross it once; it repeats while the content loads, slowly, so a wait looks calm. Use with easing.shimmer. Not for a one-time motion such as a sheet.

keyboard.$description: How long the composer dock takes to follow the on-screen keyboard up or down: the iOS 26 keyboard's own motion, measured at 60 fps on the iPad mini (screen review R37). Use with easing.keyboard. Not for sheets or other overlays.

sheetOpen.$description: How long a bottom sheet takes to slide up and its scrim to fade in (screen review R13). Use with easing.sheet. Not for closing; use duration.sheetClose.

sheetClose.$description: How long a bottom sheet takes to slide down and its scrim to fade out (screen review R13). Use with easing.sheet. Not for opening; use duration.sheetOpen.

fade.$description: How long a view that is done takes to fade out, such as the launch view of the-bridge when the app draws (screen review R66). Use with easing.fade. Not for a sheet; use duration.sheetClose.

shimmer.$description: The curve of the band that moves across a Skeleton as it shimmers: slow at both ends, so the band eases in and out of view. Use with duration.shimmer. Not for sheets or the keyboard dock.

keyboard.$description: The curve of the composer dock as it follows the on-screen keyboard: the iOS 26 keyboard's spring (1 - (1 + wt) e^(-wt), w about 23.5/s), fitted within 1.1 % over duration.keyboard (screen review R37). Use with duration.keyboard. Not for sheets; use easing.sheet.

sheet.$description: The curve of a bottom sheet and its scrim as they open and close (screen review R13). Use with duration.sheetOpen or duration.sheetClose. Not for the keyboard dock; use easing.keyboard.

fade.$description: The curve of a view that fades out when it is done, such as the launch view: it leaves fast and settles. Use with duration.fade. Not for sheets or the keyboard dock.
